description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the performance of three different models across various evaluation categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, which are ordered from left to right as PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, without a specific overarching axis label. There is no visible vertical value axis line, label, or set of tick marks; instead, the numerical values are represented by the height of the bars on a linear scale and are explicitly annotated directly above each bar. The chart utilizes grouped bars, with each group corresponding to a category on the horizontal axis and containing three individual bars representing different models, as indicated by the legend positioned below the chart. Within each group, the bars are arranged from left to right: a dark blue bar representing "RedWhale (our)", a light blue bar representing "EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0", and a light gray bar representing "SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)". The annotated values range from a minimum of 0.42, seen on the dark blue RedWhale bar in the PT-EVAL category, to a maximum of 1.00. A consistent visual characteristic is present where the light gray SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) bar is the tallest in every category, uniformly annotated with a value of 1.00 across all six groups. The dark blue RedWhale bars range from 0.42 to 0.71, and the light blue EEVE bars range from 0.46 to 0.74. The categories on the horizontal axis do not appear to be sorted alphabetically or by value, but the bars within each group follow a consistent order, and all bars are visually emphasized by the inclusion of exact numerical data labels placed just above their top edges.
